_comment: Local dry-run fixture for ig-autopost.mjs. Real ABQ events (week of 2026-06-16), pulled via Supabase MCP while the project's REST egress was capped. localTime is raw (HH:MM[:SS] or 'h:MM AM/PM') — the orchestration formats it. In prod the orchestration reads live data instead of this file.

events.title: Kenny Wayne Shepherd: The 30th Anniversary of Ledbetter Heights
events.venue: Kiva Auditorium at the Albuquerque Convention Center
events.about: Kenny Wayne Shepherd is a highly respected blues-rock guitarist known for his technical virtuosity and soulful sound. This anniversary show celebrates three decades of high-energy live performance.
highlights: Kenny Wayne Shepherd's signature blend of shredding guitar over classic blues structures.
An intimate Kiva Auditorium setting perfect for appreciating the music's depth.
events.venueTips: Kiva Auditorium is in the Albuquerque Convention Center, 401 2nd St NW (Downtown). Paid underground lot off 2nd St; street parking on Tijeras/Roma free after 6 PM. Doors 60 min before showtime.
events.localRec: Sister Bar is a 5-min walk east on Central; Java Joe's on Park Ave for coffee; Marble's Downtown taproom 7-min walk north.

events.title: Herb Alpert
events.venue: Kiva Auditorium at the Albuquerque Convention Center
events.about: Herb Alpert is an iconic figure in jazz history, celebrated for his distinctive trumpet tone and pioneering work in melding Latin rhythms with pop sensibilities.
highlights: Classic, smooth jazz arrangements blending Latin flair with pop.
The Kiva Auditorium is an intimate setting for the full breadth of his talent.
events.venueTips: Kiva Auditorium, Albuquerque Convention Center, 401 2nd St NW (Downtown). Paid lot off 2nd St; street parking free after 6 PM.
events.localRec: Sister Bar 5-min walk; Gold Street Caffe nearby for pre-show tapas.

events.title: Loverboy
events.about: Loverboy is an iconic rock powerhouse known for their high-energy anthems and soaring vocals; they bring classic arena rock vibes to the Route 66 Casino stage.
highlights: Legendary guitar riffs and singalong choruses.
A true throwback rock concert atmosphere.
events.venueTips: Route 66 Casino, 14500 Central Ave SW (I-40 Exit 140, ~17 mi west of Downtown). Legends Theater, assigned seating, free parking. Plan ~30 min drive.
events.localRec: On-site Thunder Road Steakhouse or the casino grill; Garcia's Kitchen on the West Side is open late weekends.

events.title: Yachtley Crew
events.about: Yachtley Crew brings a high-energy yacht-rock tribute sound, promising a vibrant night of soft-rock classics.
highlights: A full set of yacht-rock favorites in an intimate room.
Large free on-site parking.
events.venueTips: Revel Entertainment Center, 4720 Pan American Fwy NE (Journal Center, NE ABQ). Free lot fills early; arrive 45 min before doors.
events.localRec: Bosque Brewing's Jefferson taproom is 5 min away for post-show beer and pub fare.

events.title: San Pacho
events.about: San Pacho brings a high-energy electronic dance set to Revel, an 18-and-over night built for the dance floor.
highlights: A late-night electronic/dance set.
Raised side platforms have the best sightlines.
events.venueTips: Revel Entertainment Center, 4720 Pan American Fwy NE (Journal Center, NE ABQ). Floor is general admission and runs warm when packed.
events.localRec: Bosque Brewing Jefferson taproom 5 min; Range Cafe in North ABQ 10 min.

events.title: Joe Machi
events.about: Joe Machi brings his unique brand of stand-up comedy to the stage, with sharp wit and observational humor in an intimate club setting.
highlights: Live stand-up in a dedicated comedy room.
Front-row guests get pulled into crowd-work bits.
events.venueTips: Hyena's Comedy Nightclub, 4880 San Mateo Ln NE (Uptown, behind Coronado Center). Two-item minimum, full bar, ~140 seats. Doors 30-45 min before showtime.
events.localRec: ABQ Uptown is a 5-min walk; Flying Star on Menaul 4-min drive for a post-show dessert.

events.title: Company - The Musical - Albuquerque
events.venue: The Historic El Rey Theater - Albuquerque
events.about: Company is one of the most beloved musicals in the canon, a witty exploration of marriage and commitment through a series of vignettes set against classic Broadway charm.
highlights: Sondheim's signature vignette structure rather than a linear plot.
Staged in the historic 1941 El Rey Theater.
events.venueTips: The Historic El Rey Theater, 622 Central Ave SW (Downtown). 600+ capacity, general admission floor plus balcony. Beer/wine bar, no kitchen. Street parking free after 6 PM.
events.localRec: Sister Bar 3-min walk east; Marble Downtown taproom and Sawmill Market for after.

events.title: Company - The Musical - Albuquerque
events.venue: The Historic El Rey Theater - Albuquerque
events.about: A Sunday matinee of Company, Sondheim's witty look at marriage and commitment, staged at the historic El Rey Theater.
highlights: A relaxed Sunday matinee.
Historic 1941 El Rey Theater setting.
events.venueTips: The Historic El Rey Theater, 622 Central Ave SW (Downtown). 600+ capacity. Street parking metered until 6 PM, paid lots within 2 blocks.
events.localRec: Sister Bar 3-min walk; Java Joe's on Park for coffee.

events.title: Festival Flamenco Alburquerque 39: María Pagés-De Scheherezade
events.about: María Pagés Compañía presents De Scheherezade, a large-scale flamenco work that reframes Scheherezade as a collective female protagonist across 12 choreographic chapters set to live music blending flamenco with classical, popular, and Moroccan influences.
highlights: 12 choreographic chapters with a collective female protagonist.
Live music placing flamenco in dialogue with classical and Moroccan traditions.
events.venueTips: Roy E. Disney Center for Performing Arts on the National Hispanic Cultural Center campus, 1701 4th St SW (Barelas). Free on-campus parking; arrive 30 min early.
events.localRec: Barelas Coffee House 3 blocks north for a classic NM red-or-green plate; El Modelo for tamales.

events.title: Festival Flamenco Alburquerque 39: Yjastros-Flamenco Fandanguero
events.about: Yjastros: The American Flamenco Repertory Company presents Flamenco Fandanguero, a theatrical work blending flamenco and son jarocho with over 20 musicians and dancers on stage.
highlights: Over 20 musicians and dancers on stage.
A fusion of flamenco and son jarocho.
events.venueTips: Roy E. Disney Center for Performing Arts, National Hispanic Cultural Center, 1701 4th St SW (Barelas). Free parking; arrive 30 min early.
events.localRec: Barelas Coffee House or El Modelo for NM food nearby.

events.title: Evolution of the Blues: Joanie Cere, Michael Matison, Linda Piper
events.about: An evening tracing the evolution of the blues with Joanie Cere, Michael Matison, and Linda Piper at the Outpost Performance Space, a former church turned intimate listening room.
highlights: An intimate, acoustically rich listening-room setting.
A guided journey through blues history.
events.venueTips: The Outpost Performance Space is in EDo / East Downtown; street parking nearby. A former church with unique acoustics.

events.title: The Art of Jazz with Tracey Whitney
events.about: Vocalist Tracey Whitney brings an intimate evening of live jazz and blues to Babydoll's; the night shifts into a dance party with Old School Funk, Soul, Pop, and Salsa.
highlights: Live jazz and blues in a dedicated club.
The evening transitions into a dance floor later.
events.venueTips: Babydoll's House of Jazz & Blues is on Americas Parkway near the Sunport; parking in the lot out front.

events.title: Sugar Land Space Cowboys at Albuquerque Isotopes
events.venue: Rio Grande Credit Union Field at Isotopes Park
events.about: The Albuquerque Isotopes host the Sugar Land Space Cowboys in a classic summer minor-league matchup under the Sandia Mountains.
highlights: A family-friendly ballpark atmosphere.
The berm in left-center is a cheap, casual option for kids.
events.venueTips: Rio Grande Credit Union Field at Isotopes Park, 1601 Avenida Cesar Chavez SE (south of Downtown). Free parking; gates open 90 min before first pitch. Cash-free concessions.
events.localRec: El Pinto for a pre-game green-chile burger (12-min drive); Sister Bar for after.

events.title: A Word with Writers: Andrew Sean Greer
events.about: Andrew Sean Greer, the Pulitzer Prize-winning author of 'Less,' brings his signature blend of humor and heart to an intimate talk and book signing.
highlights: A 6 PM talk followed by a book signing.
Presented with Bookworks and the ABQ Public Library Foundation.
events.venueTips: South Broadway Cultural Center, 1025 Broadway SE. Free adjacent lot plus street parking. Doors at 5 PM.
events.localRec: The lobby features rotating local-artist exhibits; arrive early to browse.
